comparison_scope: Same-input offline replay of one retained ten-row Crossref/OpenAlex task using the prior 0.1.0 output and 0.2.0 implementation; functional-contract comparison against the provider adapters and known-DOI comparator. No human decision-quality, broad reliability, latency, analyst-time, or monetary-cost benchmark was performed.
finding: The paired output preserves the exact-DOI cluster and unclustered counts while adding one review-only warning for four records sharing an identical normalized title with four distinct DOIs. No rows are merged from title equality.

replacement_and_retirement.decision: Keep the exact DOI grouper as the 0.2.0 in-place specialization; retain provider adapters and the known-DOI comparator because their retrieval and pair-comparison use cases remain distinct.

claim_ceiling: One bounded same-input functional comparison. The new review cue did not independently establish duplicate identity, metadata correctness, improved human decisions, source authenticity, broad quality, or cost savings.
